meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'глеть'). Used as an verbal verb meaning 'to get cheeky, become insolent'.

обижать.gloss: to hurt, to offend, to bully

meanings.en: to hurt, to mistreat, to offend
meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ижать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to hurt, to offend, to bully', paired with 'обидеть'.

examples.text: Ребята, я понимаю, работа у вас такая. Но детей обижать нехорошо.
examples.trans: Guys, I understand, that's the job you have. But hurting children isn't right.

meanings.note: Core Russian pron meaning 'they' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

examples.text: Нина, не слушай. Это опять обман.
examples.trans: Nina, don't listen. It's another trick.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.en: to hand over, give back, yield
meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'давать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to hand over, give back'.

examples.text: Тимур, не наглей и отдавай товар!
examples.trans: Timur, don't get cheeky and hand over the goods!

examples.text: Федя, успокойся и отдавай срочные заказы!

meanings.note: used as an exclamation of approval

examples.trans: I know this town really well!

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'личный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('excellent').

examples.text: Квартира будет отличная. На Симашко есть новый дом.
examples.trans: It'll be an excellent flat. There's a new building on Simashko Street.

meanings.en: fraternally, like a brother, as a friend
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem '-братски').

examples.trans: For you as a friend, only six hundred euros.

examples.text: Тебе по-братски всего шестьсот евро за килограмм.
